---
title: "NYC Restaurants and Inspections"
output: 
  flexdashboard::flex_dashboard:
    orientation: columns
    vertical_layout: fill
    source_code: embed
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(flexdashboard)
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(p8105.datasets)
```

```{r}
data(rest_inspec)

nyc_food =
  rest_inspec |> 
  select(dba, boro, zipcode, cuisine_description:score, inspection_type:longitude, grade, grade_date) |> 
  mutate(grade_month = lubridate::month(grade_date), grade_year = lubridate::year(grade_date), grade_day = lubridate::day(grade_date)) |> 
  filter(!(latitude == 0 & longitude == 0), grade_year == 2019)
```


Column {data-width=650}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Manhattan Restaurants and Grades

```{r}
nyc_food |>
  filter(boro == "Manhattan", !grade %in% c("P", "Z")) |> 
  mutate(
    text_label = str_c("Restaurant name: ", dba, "\nGrade: ", grade)) |> 
  plot_ly(
    x = ~ latitude, y = ~longitude, type = "scatter", mode = "markers",
    color = ~grade, text = ~text_label, alpha = 0.3, colors = "viridis"
  )
```

Column {data-width=350}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Manhattan Restaurants and Grade Counts

```{r}
nyc_food |> 
  filter(boro == "Manhattan") |> 
  count(grade) |> 
  mutate(grade = fct_reorder(grade, n)) |> 
  plot_ly(x = ~grade, y = ~n, color = ~grade, type = "bar", colors = "viridis")
```

### Bakery Scores by Borough

```{r}
nyc_food |> 
  filter(cuisine_description == "Bakery") |> 
  mutate(boro = fct_reorder(boro, score)) |> 
  plot_ly(y = ~score, color = ~boro, type = "box", colors = "viridis")
```
